content:
tara: Heads up: customers reporting "link broken" errors when SSO signups hit SCIM. See a pile of 403s + decryption_failed in prod around 06:40 UTC. Anyone on?

josh: I pulled a sample: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 403 body:{externalId:"ENC:AQICA..."}
error: decryption_failed cause: AccessDeniedException: arn:aws:sts::11111111:assumed-role/scim-worker is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:11111111:key/abcd-1234
```

priya: Correlation: we deployed SAML NameID format change yesterday (email->transient) in web-sso, and infra ran a KMS key rotation that tightened key policy to role scim-worker-v2. Old extids were encrypted with extid_context=okta-email; new flow expects okta-transient. Twofold mismatch.

infra-bot: Audit: role-change PR #799 removed scim-worker IAM role; KMS rotation PR #804 updated key policy to allow only scim-worker-v2.

tara: Mitigation: shortest path is to temporarily add scim-worker back to key policy (or add scim-worker-v2 to old key) so decrypt works, then run a rewrap job that tries both contexts ["okta-email","okta-transient"], canonicalize to "okta-transient".

josh: Also need a mapping backfill for users where NameID changed format so SCIM links existing acct by email->transient mapping. I can write a db migration that uses last_known_email to stitch accounts.

priya: Compliance note: mass decrypt requires privacy approval. File COMP-827 and ensure plaintext only in memory during rewrap; log only customer_id and outcome.

securitybot: Incident INC-2026-678 created (sev:medium). Playbook suggested: revert RBAC prune OR widen KMS policy for transition window; run dry-run rewrap; audit results; then rotate principals and remove legacy contexts after 7 days.

tara: I'll open RBAC-revert PR with 1hr auto-expire tag, josh please start rewrap dry-run with --dry-run. Post counts here when ready.
